stage_4_kill_switch.method: Stage 3 + portfolio DD > 8% -> flat 20 days (reactive kill)
stage_4_kill_switch.bug_found: Initial code used acct['total_equity'] (wrong field) → fixed to acct['equity']
stage_4_kill_switch.interpretation: kill-switch WORKS at reactive level (rescued leg#17) but doesn't fundamentally fix MDD > 12% in legs #7/13/15/17/25/31/35. The DD happens within a rebalance cycle (intra-20d), so by the time kill triggers the damage is already done. Need either (a) more frequent DD check (on_bar), or (b) preemptive position-sizing, or (c) smaller top_k for diversification.
